work.title: Untitled (Blue Ground Figures) 1
work.description: Vivid turquoise ground supports layered paint, ink drawing, and collaged paper fragments across a wide horizontal field. Gestural black line figures, floral marks, bare tree branches, and schematic faces emerge from dense overlapping yellow, pink, green, and grey passages.
work.composition: Wide horizontal field, figures scattered across ground
keywords: schematic face line drawing mixed media
